scope: 45 development questions; one existing generator; anchor_first context

correctness.2: Answers all required reference points without a substantive error; on an unanswerable question explicitly declines to invent the missing value.
correctness.1: Provides some required information but omits or gets another material point wrong.
correctness.0: Does not answer the required information, contradicts a central reference point, or invents an answer to an unanswerable question. An appropriate refusal on an answerable question may be faithful but is still incomplete.

faithfulness.2: All substantive assertions are supported by the provided retrieved context, or the answer accurately reports that this context is insufficient.
faithfulness.1: Some assertions are unsupported, although substantial parts are grounded.
faithfulness.0: A central assertion is unsupported by or contradicts the provided context. Truth elsewhere in the full paper does not by itself establish faithfulness.

citation_support.2: Every cited source supports its associated substantive claims.
citation_support.1: Some citation-claim associations are only partly supported.
citation_support.0: No supporting citation, an invalid reference number, or a central cited claim is unsupported.
citation_support.null: No substantive paper-content assertion needing a citation, such as a pure insufficiency response.

citation_coverage.2: All substantive paper-content assertions have a supporting citation.
citation_coverage.1: Some substantive assertions have supporting citations and others do not.
citation_coverage.0: No substantive assertion has a supporting citation.
citation_coverage.null: No substantive paper-content assertions requiring a citation.

review_policy: Record answer hash, reviewer type, reference points, cited sources and reasoning. AI source review is provisional, not independent human judgment. Keep human review pending. Citation-number validity and gold-source overlap are diagnostics, not semantic citation accuracy.
